notes: Both families together. Families split in the evening — Rathi family return to Tokyo (fly SFO Jun 15), Puniani family continue to Osaka. Peace Museum left flexible for Day 15 morning — whoever has time before departing Hiroshima.

days.theme: Miyajima — floating torii · Mt Misen full hike · families split

slots.title: Shinkansen Kyoto → Hiroshima
slots.description: Tokaido/Sanyo Shinkansen from Kyoto Station to Hiroshima. ~55 min on Nozomi, ~1hr 15 on Hikari. Nozomi is fastest but not covered by JR Pass — either is fine on Suica. Eat breakfast on the train or at Kyoto Station before boarding.
slots.nav: Kyoto Station · Shinkansen platforms (numbered gates) · Sanyo Shinkansen toward Hiroshima · Search 'Hiroshima Station'
tips: ~55 min on Nozomi · ~1hr 15 on Hikari · buy ekiben at Kyoto Station if not had breakfast

slots.title: Arrive Hiroshima · travel to Miyajimaguchi
slots.description: JR Sanyo Line from Hiroshima Station to Miyajimaguchi Station (~25 min, ¥410). Walk 5 min to ferry pier. Ferries run every 15 min from 6:25am. 10-min crossing to Miyajima. ¥200 per person (includes ¥100 visitor tax). JR ferry available but Matsudai Kisen ferry also fine.
slots.nav: Hiroshima Station · JR Sanyo Line platform → Miyajimaguchi Station (~25 min) · Walk 5 min to ferry pier · Suica taps throughout · Search 'Miyajimaguchi Ferry Terminal'
tips: JR Sanyo Line ¥410 · ferry ¥200 every 15 min · Suica accepted

slots.title: Arrive Miyajima — floating torii + Itsukushima Shrine
slots.description: 10-min ferry crossing. Arrive at Miyajima ferry terminal. Walk 10 min to Itsukushima Shrine and the floating torii gate. Check the tide times before visiting — the torii is most dramatic at high tide (fully floating) or low tide (walk up to it). Deer roam freely around the island.
slots.nav: Ferry to Miyajima terminal · 10 min walk along the waterfront to Itsukushima Shrine · Search 'Itsukushima Shrine Miyajima' · floating torii is visible from the ferry approach
tips: Check tide times before the day — torii most dramatic at high tide · deer everywhere · ¥300 entry to Itsukushima Shrine

slots.title: Omotesando Street — snack + supplies
slots.description: Main shopping street from ferry terminal. Pick up water, snacks for the hike. Famous for momiji manju (maple leaf cakes — Miyajima's signature snack). Oysters grilled on the street if anyone wants a taste. Get a tourist map at the ferry terminal.
slots.nav: Walk from Itsukushima Shrine back toward ferry terminal · Omotesando Street runs parallel to the waterfront · Search 'Omotesando Street Miyajima'
tips: Buy water for the hike here · momiji manju are the local snack · get a trail map at the ferry terminal

slots.title: Travel to Daisho-in trailhead
slots.description: 25-30 min walk from the ferry terminal to Daisho-in trailhead, passing the shrine and Daisho-in Temple. Or take the free shuttle to Momijidani ropeway station (every 20 min from 9:50am) if using ropeway. For the full hike: Daisho-in Course is recommended — best views, least steep, ~1.5-2 hrs to summit.
slots.nav: Walk from Omotesando past Itsukushima Shrine south toward Daisho-in Temple · Search 'Daisho-in Temple Miyajima' · trailhead is just past the temple
tips: Daisho-in Course recommended — best views, least steep · ~25-30 min walk from ferry terminal to trailhead

slots.title: Mt Misen — full hike to summit
slots.description: Daisho-in Course to summit: ~1.5-2 hrs up, 535m peak. Ancient cedar forest, large boulders, sacred sites along the way. At the summit: 360-degree views of Seto Inland Sea, Reikado Hall with the 1,200-year eternal flame (same flame used to light Hiroshima's Flame of Peace). Wear proper shoes — steep in places, over 2,000 stone steps on Daisho-in descent. Bring water. No food at summit — bring snacks.
slots.nav: Follow Daisho-in Course trail markers from Daisho-in Temple · trail is well-marked · summit ~1.5-2 hrs · Search 'Mt Misen Summit Miyajima'
tips: Proper shoes essential · bring water and snacks · 1.5-2 hrs up · summit has toilets and vending machines · start descent by 3pm

slots.title: Summit — views + Reikado Hall
slots.description: Allow 30-45 min at the top. 360-degree views of Seto Inland Sea on clear days — Hiroshima city visible in the distance. Visit Reikado Hall (the eternal flame), Misen Hondo (main hall), Kuguri Iwa (large rock with a hole said to grant wishes). Ropeway down is an option from Shishi-iwa Observatory (~30 min walk from summit) — last down 4:30pm.
slots.nav: At summit · Shishi-iwa Observatory is 30 min walk for ropeway down · ropeway last descent 4:30pm · Search 'Mt Misen Ropeway Miyajima'
tips: Ropeway down: ¥1,100 one way · last descent 4:30pm · or hike down ~1.5 hrs · start descent by 3pm for safety

slots.title: Descend Mt Misen
slots.description: Either hike down Momijidani Course (~1.5 hrs, through maple forest) or take ropeway down from Shishi-iwa Observatory (30 min walk from summit, 20-min ropeway, ¥1,100). Ropeway last descent 4:30pm — if cutting it close, take the ropeway. Tired legs after the Kurama hike yesterday — ropeway is sensible.
slots.nav: From summit: hike Momijidani Course down OR walk 30 min to Shishi-iwa for ropeway · ropeway → Momijidani Station → 10 min walk to ferry terminal area · Search 'Miyajima Ropeway Station'
tips: Ropeway recommended if tired · ¥1,100 · last descent 4:30pm · don't miss it

slots.title: Back in town — rest + late lunch/snack
slots.description: Back at Miyajima town level. Rest legs, grab food. Oysters are Miyajima's other signature — grilled on the street or in restaurants. Plenty of options near the ferry terminal. Vegetarians: grilled rice balls, tofu dishes, tempura vegetable sets.
slots.nav: Near ferry terminal and Omotesando Street · Search 'restaurant Miyajima Island'
tips: Oysters are the local speciality · grilled on the street · vegetarians: grilled rice balls and tempura available

slots.title: Floating torii at dusk
slots.description: Return to the torii gate area for the golden hour and dusk. Completely different atmosphere from the morning — light is soft, crowds thinner, the torii glows. Check tide for best effect. Walk along the waterfront around Itsukushima Shrine. This is the image of Miyajima you'll remember.
slots.nav: Walk from restaurant area back to Itsukushima Shrine waterfront · Search 'Itsukushima Shrine floating torii Miyajima' · sunset ~7pm in June
tips: Golden hour starts ~6pm · crowds thinner than morning · torii most photogenic at dusk

slots.title: Ferry back to Miyajimaguchi — families split
slots.description: Last ferries run late into the evening. Take the ferry back to Miyajimaguchi (~10 min). From here the families go different ways. This is the split point.
slots.nav: Walk to Miyajima ferry terminal · ferry every 15 min to Miyajimaguchi · Search 'Miyajima Ferry Terminal'
tips: Ferries run until ~10pm · last JR ferry check timetable on the day

slots.title: Rathi family — Hiroshima → Tokyo
slots.description: JR Sanyo Line from Miyajimaguchi → Hiroshima Station (~25 min). Shinkansen Hiroshima → Tokyo (~4 hrs). Fly SFO Jun 15 from Haneda.
slots.nav: Miyajimaguchi Station · JR Sanyo Line → Hiroshima Station · Shinkansen Tokyo direction · Search 'Hiroshima Station Shinkansen'
tips: Book Shinkansen Hiroshima→Tokyo in advance · ~4 hrs · arrive Tokyo late evening

slots.title: Puniani family — Hiroshima → Osaka
slots.description: JR Sanyo Line from Miyajimaguchi → Hiroshima Station (~25 min). Shinkansen Hiroshima → Shin-Osaka (~1 hr 15 min). Check in to Namba/Dotonbori apartment. Jun 15 morning: Peace Museum is a 30-min walk or tram from Hiroshima Station — if time allows before departing, do it then.
slots.nav: Miyajimaguchi Station · JR Sanyo Line → Hiroshima Station · Shinkansen Osaka direction → Shin-Osaka · Search 'Shin-Osaka Station'
tips: ~1hr 15 to Shin-Osaka · Namba/Dotonbori apartment waiting · Peace Museum Jun 15 morning if desired

days.rain_plan: Miyajima and Mt Misen are outdoors — light rain is manageable with ponchos and adds atmosphere. If heavy rain makes the hike unsafe, skip Mt Misen and spend more time at Itsukushima Shrine, Daisho-in Temple, and the island town instead. The Peace Museum in Hiroshima city is fully indoors and works well as an alternative anchor if Miyajima is a washout.
days.notes: Tide times: check Miyajima tide chart for Jun 14 before the day — plan torii visits around high/low tide for best effect. Okonomimura (Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki building, 6 floors of restaurants) is near Hiroshima Station — good for a quick lunch option if spending time in Hiroshima city rather than going straight to Miyajima. Vegetarian note: Okonomimura can make vegetarian okonomiyaki on request. Peace Museum: open 8:30am-6pm, ¥200 adults. Allow minimum 2 hours — don't rush it.

practical.transport: Suica works throughout. Kyoto→Hiroshima Shinkansen ~55 min (Nozomi) or ~1hr 15 (Hikari). Hiroshima→Miyajimaguchi JR Sanyo Line ~25 min ¥410. Ferry Miyajimaguchi→Miyajima ~10 min ¥200 every 15 min.
practical.mt_misen: Three trails: Daisho-in Course (best views, recommended), Momijidani Course (shortest, steepest), Omoto Course (longest). All ~1.5-2 hrs to summit. Ropeway alternative: ¥1,100 one way, ¥2,000 return, operates 9am-4pm (last down 4:30pm). Wear proper shoes. Bring water — no food at summit.
practical.food_vegetarians: Miyajima: grilled rice balls, tempura vegetable sets, tofu dishes available. Okonomimura Hiroshima: vegetarian okonomiyaki available on request. Peace Museum area: cafes near the park.
practical.families_split: Split point is Miyajimaguchi after the ferry back from Miyajima. Rathi: JR Sanyo→Hiroshima→Shinkansen Tokyo (~4 hrs). Puniani: JR Sanyo→Hiroshima→Shinkansen Osaka (~1hr 15). Peace Museum available Jun 15 morning for whoever has time before departing Hiroshima.
practical.peace_museum: Hiroshima Peace Memorial Museum: open 8:30am-6pm, ¥200 adults. 10 min walk from Hiroshima Station or tram stop Genbaku Dome-mae. Allow minimum 2 hours. Jun 15 morning option for both families before departing.
